# Synthetic benchmark validation fixture

This directory contains test data only. It is not a LugandaGPT benchmark item,
prompt set, reference answer, review record, or evaluation result.

The single JSONL record exists to exercise the item schema and the local
validator. Its prompt is written in English and begins with
`SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE` so it cannot be mistaken for benchmark content.

No native-speaker review has been performed on this file.
